study.source_policy: Public sources only. Every cell cites a reference id and a locator. A fact with no public source is unknown with a reason. Wording is ours unless quoted.

legal_form.value: Delaware public benefit corporation, incorporated January 2021

essential_why.value: The responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity (the Company Purpose in its certificate of incorporation).

ref.locator: Prospectus Summary, Our Governance Structure and Its Goals

self_description.value: First and foremost a research lab; also calls itself a platform company.

ref.locator: Prospectus Summary, Enterprise Adoption of Claude

phase.note: Our reading against Naive's phases: more than 11,900 customers at $100k+ TTM and revenue of $16.3B for the six months ended 2026-06-30. It claims Platform (others build on its primitives); Platform is not yet established to standard.

promise.value: Organisations can hand Claude real professional work and trust what comes back: frontier capability that is safe, steerable and predictable enough for mission-critical work.

ref.locator: Prospectus Summary, Overview and Claude as a Virtual Collaborator

promise.note: Our wording of the S-1's claims.

promised_to.value: Enterprises and the knowledge workers and developers inside them.

must_not.value: Catastrophic misuse, misaligned or unsanctioned autonomous action, or harm delivered under its name.

competence.value: Frontier and safety research done as one programme, on one fungible multi-chip compute pool, with each model helping build the next (closing the loop).

ref.locator: Prospectus Summary, Our Commitment to Public Benefit

holds.note: A wholly owned subsidiary holding 5% of fully diluted shares (Class N) for the Company Purpose. Ode with Anthropic is a partnership with private equity firms; the S-1 does not say Anthropic controls it, so it is not listed as held.

decisions.decision: File to list Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.

ref.locator: Cover; Prospectus Summary, Controlled Company Status
